user_query: My friends and I are planning a superhero-themed party. Can you suggest some random heroes and villains for us to dress up as? It would be great if you could also provide a random fact about the year 2000 to add some trivia to our event.

TaskList.description: Generate a list of random superhero and villain characters for dressing up.
